ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Brand mark, filled button surfaces, key highlights, illustration accents — the singular chromatic accent across the entire system, used as punctuation rather than wash

iris-ink.$description: Iris Ink — Illustration-only accent (buildings, shadows in hero artwork) — never use in UI chrome, buttons, or text

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Primary canvas, card surfaces, input backgrounds — the signature warm white that replaces stark #ffffff

parchment.$description: Parchment — Secondary surface, alternating section bands, soft elevated cards — one step warmer than the canvas

stone-linen.$description: Stone Linen — Hairline borders, dividers, muted surface tints — the structural separator color

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Muted borders, disabled-state backgrounds, low-contrast dividers

ash-mist.$description: Ash Mist — Disabled text, placeholder text, very subtle borders

ink-brown.$description: Ink Brown — Primary text, dark UI elements, logo wordmark — warm near-black, not #000000

bark.$description: Bark — Secondary headings, nav text, medium-emphasis body copy

coffee-stone.$description: Coffee Stone — Tertiary text, link text in resting state, breadcrumb text

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Muted helper text, captions, metadata, small-print compliance lines

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Icons at maximum contrast, footer text on light surfaces, logo mark detail

inter.$description: Primary UI and body typeface. Inter carries all functional text — nav items, buttons, form fields, card body, captions. Weight 500 for button labels and nav, 400 for body, 600 for emphasis. Negative tracking tightens as size grows.

degular-display.$description: Display face for hero headlines, section headings, and uppercase eyebrow labels. Runs POSITIVE letter-spacing (0.020–0.071em) — counter-intuitive for display type, which gives headings an open, almost editorial-poster feel. The custom face is the primary brand-typography signal; do not substitute it with a tightened grotesque.

gt-alpina.$description: Editorial accent serif for select headings that need a magazine-like lift — used sparingly, never for body or UI. Weight 250 (ultra-light) is the signature: a whisper-weight serif that contrasts the geometric Degular Display and adds human warmth to the system.

arial.$description: System fallback only — appears in third-party embed contexts, not a design choice
